reuse.why: It adds a single check helper, but does not hook it into linkBankSyncAccount, the existing shared path every provider already goes through with account_sync_source and account_id in its fields.

duplication.why: The guard call is repeated in all five provider functions, and each one restates its provider literal, which is already given again a few lines later in fields.account_sync_source.

placement.why: The check lives in accounts/app.ts next to the link logic and runs before any write. Calling it in the provider wrappers instead of the shared link function is a defensible way to avoid findOrCreateBank side effects, but it spreads the wiring.

scope.why: The change is focused on the rule plus tests; there is only a stray blank-line removal in an unrelated test.

maintainability.why: The SQL rule is defined once, but a sixth provider would need someone to remember to call the guard, and the provider string can drift from the one passed to linkBankSyncAccount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every link path calls the new guard; linkBankSyncAccount is still used. The guard just sits beside it instead of inside it.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated guard invocations are plain, not reshaped.

one_place.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in accounts/app.ts defines the rule (non-tombstoned, same provider and account id, excluding upgradingId), and all five provider link functions call it. The invocation is repeated per provider rather than made once in linkBankSyncAccount.
